The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：一个男人，“别人” distinguishes other people from a stated person; here the helper is a new character, so introduce him with an indefinite noun phrase. [teacher rule: bieren]

items.reason: “别人” cannot introduce a new helper here; “一个男人” is grammatical, but it arbitrarily specifies the helper's gender rather than using the appropriate “另外一个人”.
